roles.title: Store Care Helper (weekday mornings)
roles.summary: Keeps the sales floor clean and clear: sweeping and mopping, emptying trash, and breaking down boxes after stocking. Associates can stay on the register and with customers during the morning rush.
roles.schedule: 3 weekday mornings, about 9:00-12:00, set around Madison Metro or paratransit times
roles.pay_note: same $16-18 starting range as other associates
supports: picture checklist of the cleaning route at the supply closet
phone timer for the every-2-hours trash round
one named coworker to ask when supplies run out
job coach for the first week, then fading
roles.frees_up: associates who leave the register to sweep, empty trash, or clear boxes
roles.why_this_bundle: all floor-care tasks on one route, one supply closet, done in the quieter morning
roles.growth_path: add facing shelves (t5), then restroom cleaning with a cleaning log (t7), then stocking (t4)

variations.name: Core
variations.best_when: prefers one task at a time on a fixed route and a short shift

variations.name: Standard
variations.best_when: ready for three floor-care tasks on one route

variations.name: Plus
variations.best_when: has mastered floor care and wants to add facing shelves

roles.title: Front Lot and Welcome Helper
roles.summary: Keeps carts flowing from the lot to the entrance and greets customers at the door, pointing them to aisles or handing questions to a coworker.
roles.schedule: weekday late mornings into lunch, when cart traffic is highest; daylight only
roles.pay_note: same $16-18 starting range as other associates
supports: parking-lot safety training and a high-visibility vest
short greeting script and a store map card for product questions
a buddy at customer service to hand harder questions to
job coach on site for the first weeks; check-ins every 2 weeks
breaks in a quiet area; weather gear provided
roles.frees_up: cashiers called out to the lot when carts run low
roles.why_this_bundle: both tasks sit at the front entrance and share the same busy window
roles.growth_path: add facing shelves (t5), then expiration checks (t12), then register backup only if the person wants it

variations.name: Core
variations.best_when: likes moving around outdoors and prefers little customer conversation

variations.name: Standard
variations.best_when: comfortable with short, scripted greetings between cart rounds

roles.title: Shelf and Freshness Helper
roles.summary: Keeps shelves full-looking and safe: faces products forward and pulls expired items from a set list of aisles each day.
roles.schedule: weekday mornings after the delivery is stocked
roles.pay_note: same $16-18 starting range as other associates
supports: aisle-by-aisle route card for each day
picture guide to reading date codes, with a magnifier if wanted
picture log or a scan-only log for pulled items
supervisor sets which aisles to check each day
job coach on site for the first weeks; check-ins every 2 weeks
roles.frees_up: stockers and managers who check dates at closing
roles.why_this_bundle: both tasks walk the same aisles and use the same 'shelf looks right' standard
roles.growth_path: add stocking with date rotation (t4), then price tags (t13)

variations.name: Core
variations.best_when: wants to learn the aisles by facing before checking dates

variations.name: Standard
variations.best_when: comfortable reading date codes with a picture guide

variations.name: Plus
variations.best_when: ready to stock with date rotation

questions_for_employer: Is 'lift up to 50 lbs' essential for every associate, or only for unloading trucks? The helper roles carry lighter loads.
Can these roles be weekday daytime only? The posting asks for evenings and weekends.
Confirm the starting wage for helpers is the same $16-18 range as associates.
Is 'strong multitasking in a fast-paced environment' needed for these roles, or only for register work?
Who supervises each role, and who is the backup?
What cleaning chemicals are used, and what safety training do all staff get?
Does the parking lot have a safe walking path for cart retrieval?
How are pulled expired items logged today?
Would you start with one person in one role, then decide on more?
guardrail_notes: Register, cash, baler, complaints, and opening or closing stay with current staff (keep-with-staff).
Support intensity describes each role, not who may apply. Hours or pay changes go to an ERI benefits counselor.
